spans.s:
अश्रद्ध॑ a. = seq.;
 f. अ॑शद्धा disbelief.
अश्रद्धधान a. unbelieving, having no faith.
अश्रद्धेय a. incredible.
1 अश्रम m. absence of fatigue.
अ॑श्रम a. unwearied, indefatigable.
2 अश्रम॑ a. unwearied, indefatigable.

अश्रवण n. the not being heard, the not occurring (in a
text), absence, want (of a word, suffix, etc.).
आश्रा॑वण n. call ((r.)).
अश्राद्धिन् a. not performing funeral meals.
अ॑श्रान्त a. indefatigable, n. adv.
अ॑श्रि f. (adj. —˚ अश्रिक) edge, corner.
अ॑श्रु n. (m.) a tear.
अश्रुकण्ठ a. having tears in the throat.
अ॑श्रुत a. unheard.
अश्रुधारा f. flood of tears.

अश्रेयंस् a. worse;
 n. ill luck.
अश्रोत्र॑ a. earless.
अ॑श्रोत्रिय a. not knowing the Veda.
1 अस्र n. a tear.
2 अस्र॑ a. throwing, hurling.
अस्रमुख f. ई having tears in the face.*

अस्रि॑ध् a. not going wrong;
 safe, harmless.
अ॑स्रिधान a. the same.
अ॑स्रेधन्त् a. the same.
अस्रेम॑न् a. faultless, perfect.

आश्रमवासिन् m. inhabitant of a hermitage, hermit,
ascetic.
आश्रमिन् a. belonging to one of the orders of religious life.
आश्रयणीय a. to be approached for protection.

आश्रयभूत a. being the refuge, support, recipient, or
subject of (gen. or —˚).

आश्रयिन् a. leaning on, attaching to;
 dwelling in (—˚).

आश्रव a. obedient;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

आस्राव॑ m. flowing out, efflux, suppuration, diarrhoea,
i.g. disease, bodily pain.

आश्रित्य ger. resorting to, taking care of (acc.), often =
because or for the sake of.
आ॑श्रुति f. reach of hearing.
†आश्रुत्कर्ण a. having ears to hear.
आश्रे॑ष m. embracer (a demon).
आस्रस्त a. fallen off.
